---
title: "JackMoebius license activation in JackMate"
description: "Watch the walkthrough and open JackMate's License panel to activate JackMoebius."
---

**Opening JackMate…** its **License** panel should appear in a moment. Paste your license key
(it's in your purchase email) and click **Activate**. Here's the walkthrough:

```{=html}
<figure style="max-width:720px; margin:1.4rem auto 0;">
  <video class="scroll-video" src="assets/video/activate-jackmoebius-from-jackmate.mp4"
         muted playsinline preload="metadata"
         style="width:100%; display:block; border-radius:12px; border:1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.12);"></video>
</figure>
<div style="text-align:center; margin:1.3rem 0 .4rem;">
  <a id="open-jm" class="hero-pill hero-pill-primary" href="jackmate://activate">
    <i class="fa-solid fa-arrow-up-right-from-square"></i> Open in JackMate
  </a>
</div>
<p id="jm-key" style="text-align:center; display:none; color:var(--jm-text-dim);">Your license key: <code></code></p>
<script>
(function () {
  // A ?key= (passed from the purchase email) pre-fills activation; the PDF link
  // carries no key, so this just opens JackMate's License panel — paste it there.
  var key = new URLSearchParams(location.search).get('key');
  var btn = document.getElementById('open-jm');
  if (key) {
    btn.href = 'jackmate://activate?key=' + encodeURIComponent(key);
    var box = document.getElementById('jm-key');
    box.querySelector('code').textContent = key;
    box.style.display = '';
  }
  // Best-effort: try to open JackMate automatically shortly after load; the button
  // stays for a manual retry.
  setTimeout(function () { try { window.location.href = btn.href; } catch (e) {} }, 900);
})();
</script>
```

::: {.callout-note appearance="simple"}
**Nothing happens?** JackMate may not be installed. [Get JackMate](https://jackmate.app)
(it's free), then open it, go to the **License** panel, and paste your key.
:::
